semantics.sharedSnapshots: ABSTRACTION/N1/N2/REQUEST totals span runs. Only cumulative counters use END−START; gauges and maxima retain endpoint values.
semantics.runAggregates: CFG and BODY_WORK are exact per-run event snapshots over reported actors. Missing/unavailable actors are explicit; aborted snapshots are partial.
semantics.loopMethods: Complete runs print up to24 loop owners selected by actor.steps. Aborted runs print loops among the union of top12-by-steps and top12-by-candidates stopped owners; the total loop-owner population is unavailable. Operation counts are partial per-run within that subset; gauges are kept per owner.
semantics.bodySamples: Stages 0/1/2 are processed/fresh-post-statement/summary-candidate packet events; memberships use deterministic first16 then each1024 packet sampling, capped traversal and bounded samples.
semantics.census: RelationCensus gauges count memberships/rows at the barrier, with outgoing including eligible NORMAL guidance. block* are included in admitted/outgoing; do not sum them again.
limits: No duplicate-work inference from candidate or callback counts alone.
No complete origin/rule pipeline or first-loss proof from bounded samples alone.
An ended engine is not a committed handoff; use analyze_campaign.py for commit and accepted-report evidence.
No current quality result is produced.

ratios.name: cyclicProcessedShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; exact packet events
ratios.interpretation: Cyclic-CFG processed packet share; not a causation/provenance proof.

ratios.name: candidateOffersPerProcessed
ratios.scope: all measured actors; different packet-event stages
ratios.interpretation: Stage volume ratio; not a duplicate-work percentage.

ratios.name: blockCandidateShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; summary candidate packets
ratios.interpretation: Internal-block share of summary candidate offers.

ratios.name: cfgCacheHitShare
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG delivery calls
ratios.interpretation: Cache hits / (hits + searches).

ratios.name: cfgNodesPerSearch
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG BFS
ratios.interpretation: Visited CFG nodes per cache miss search.

ratios.name: loopObservationsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Observation invocations per scalar subject to the growing-summary gate; each baseline and each cut trial invokes observe.

ratios.name: loopTrialsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Prefix-cut trials per scalar; repeated observations are intentional tests of distinct cuts, not proved duplicate work.

ratios.name: loopC2CacheHitShare
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Invocation-local C2 cache hits / C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC2RowsPerNativeQuery
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Returned C2 rows / actual uncached C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC5ChecksPerNewPlan
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Native entry/row preparation checks per newly prepared plan.

ratios.name: loopPreparedC5Share
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Successful prepared C5 queries / (prepared successes + native fallbacks).

ratios.name: loopSavedPositionsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Saved output positions examined per selector query. Selector totals mix real replay and pure observations.

ratios.name: loopSavedViewsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Reversed selected views per selector query; not a unique-record count.

ratios.name: loopPublicationSelectedVsLinearBound
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Index-selected publication candidates / theoretical complete linear-pair bound. The bound is not work actually performed.

ratios.name: loopCallbacksPerNativeMatch
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: DATA callbacks / successful native local relation matches; counts can include ND and multi-output geometry.

ratios.name: selectedCallEmptyDemandShare
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Empty demand lookups / all selected-call demand lookups.

ratios.name: persistedCandidatesPerReplay
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Candidate records / persisted replay invocation, not duplicate facts.

ratios.name: newInitialsPerCandidate
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Admitted fresh initials / initial candidates under the native admission counter.

sampledAnnotationRatios.interpretation: Annotation multiplicity of sampled packets; not an exact population-wide edge count.

sampledAnnotationRatios.interpretation: Annotation multiplicity of sampled packets; not an exact population-wide edge count.

ratios.name: loopPreparedC5Share
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Successful prepared C5 queries / (prepared successes + native fallbacks).

ratios.name: loopSavedPositionsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census

ratios.name: loopSavedViewsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Reversed selected views per selector query; not a unique-record count.

ratios.name: loopPublicationSelectedVsLinearBound
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Index-selected publication candidates / theoretical complete linear-pair bound. The bound is not work actually performed.

ratios.name: loopCallbacksPerNativeMatch
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: DATA callbacks / successful native local relation matches; counts can include ND and multi-output geometry.

ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Empty demand lookups / all selected-call demand lookups.

ratios.name: persistedCandidatesPerReplay

ratios.interpretation: Candidate records / persisted replay invocation, not duplicate facts.

ratios.interpretation: Admitted fresh initials / initial candidates under the native admission counter.

ratios.name: cyclicProcessedShare

ratios.interpretation: Stage volume ratio; not a duplicate-work percentage.

ratios.scope: all measured actors; summary candidate packets
ratios.interpretation: Internal-block share of summary candidate offers.

ratios.name: cfgCacheHitShare
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG delivery calls
ratios.interpretation: Cache hits / (hits + searches).

ratios.name: cfgNodesPerSearch
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG BFS
ratios.interpretation: Visited CFG nodes per cache miss search.

ratios.name: loopObservationsPerScalar

ratios.name: loopTrialsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Prefix-cut trials per scalar; repeated observations are intentional tests of distinct cuts, not proved duplicate work.

ratios.name: loopC2CacheHitShare
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Invocation-local C2 cache hits / C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC2RowsPerNativeQuery

ratios.interpretation: Returned C2 rows / actual uncached C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC5ChecksPerNewPlan
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Native entry/row preparation checks per newly prepared plan.

ratios.name: loopPreparedC5Share
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Successful prepared C5 queries / (prepared successes + native fallbacks).

ratios.name: loopSavedPositionsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Saved output positions examined per selector query. Selector totals mix real replay and pure observations.

ratios.name: loopSavedViewsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Reversed selected views per selector query; not a unique-record count.

ratios.name: loopPublicationSelectedVsLinearBound
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Index-selected publication candidates / theoretical complete linear-pair bound. The bound is not work actually performed.

ratios.name: loopCallbacksPerNativeMatch
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: DATA callbacks / successful native local relation matches; counts can include ND and multi-output geometry.

ratios.name: selectedCallEmptyDemandShare
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Empty demand lookups / all selected-call demand lookups.

ratios.name: persistedCandidatesPerReplay

ratios.interpretation: Candidate records / persisted replay invocation, not duplicate facts.

ratios.interpretation: Admitted fresh initials / initial candidates under the native admission counter.

ratios.name: cyclicProcessedShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; exact packet events
ratios.interpretation: Cyclic-CFG processed packet share; not a causation/provenance proof.

ratios.name: candidateOffersPerProcessed
ratios.scope: all measured actors; different packet-event stages
ratios.interpretation: Stage volume ratio; not a duplicate-work percentage.

ratios.name: blockCandidateShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; summary candidate packets
ratios.interpretation: Internal-block share of summary candidate offers.

ratios.name: cfgCacheHitShare
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG delivery calls
ratios.interpretation: Cache hits / (hits + searches).

ratios.name: cfgNodesPerSearch
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG BFS
ratios.interpretation: Visited CFG nodes per cache miss search.

ratios.name: loopObservationsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Observation invocations per scalar subject to the growing-summary gate; each baseline and each cut trial invokes observe.

ratios.name: loopTrialsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Prefix-cut trials per scalar; repeated observations are intentional tests of distinct cuts, not proved duplicate work.

ratios.name: loopC2CacheHitShare
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Invocation-local C2 cache hits / C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC2RowsPerNativeQuery
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Returned C2 rows / actual uncached C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC5ChecksPerNewPlan
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Native entry/row preparation checks per newly prepared plan.

ratios.name: loopPreparedC5Share
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Successful prepared C5 queries / (prepared successes + native fallbacks).

ratios.name: loopSavedPositionsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Saved output positions examined per selector query. Selector totals mix real replay and pure observations.

ratios.name: loopSavedViewsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Reversed selected views per selector query; not a unique-record count.

ratios.name: loopPublicationSelectedVsLinearBound
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Index-selected publication candidates / theoretical complete linear-pair bound. The bound is not work actually performed.

ratios.name: loopCallbacksPerNativeMatch
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: DATA callbacks / successful native local relation matches; counts can include ND and multi-output geometry.

ratios.name: selectedCallEmptyDemandShare
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Empty demand lookups / all selected-call demand lookups.

ratios.name: persistedCandidatesPerReplay
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Candidate records / persisted replay invocation, not duplicate facts.

ratios.name: newInitialsPerCandidate
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Admitted fresh initials / initial candidates under the native admission counter.

ratios.interpretation: Internal-block share of summary candidate offers.

ratios.interpretation: Cache hits / (hits + searches).

ratios.name: loopPreparedC5Share

ratios.interpretation: Successful prepared C5 queries / (prepared successes + native fallbacks).

ratios.name: loopSavedPositionsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census

ratios.name: loopSavedViewsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Reversed selected views per selector query; not a unique-record count.

ratios.name: loopPublicationSelectedVsLinearBound
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Index-selected publication candidates / theoretical complete linear-pair bound. The bound is not work actually performed.

ratios.name: loopCallbacksPerNativeMatch
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: DATA callbacks / successful native local relation matches; counts can include ND and multi-output geometry.

ratios.interpretation: Candidate records / persisted replay invocation, not duplicate facts.

ratios.name: cyclicProcessedShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; exact packet events
ratios.interpretation: Cyclic-CFG processed packet share; not a causation/provenance proof.

ratios.name: candidateOffersPerProcessed
ratios.scope: all measured actors; different packet-event stages
ratios.interpretation: Stage volume ratio; not a duplicate-work percentage.

ratios.name: blockCandidateShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; summary candidate packets
ratios.interpretation: Internal-block share of summary candidate offers.

ratios.name: cfgCacheHitShare
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG delivery calls
ratios.interpretation: Cache hits / (hits + searches).

ratios.name: cfgNodesPerSearch
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG BFS
ratios.interpretation: Visited CFG nodes per cache miss search.

ratios.name: loopObservationsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Observation invocations per scalar subject to the growing-summary gate; each baseline and each cut trial invokes observe.

ratios.name: loopTrialsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Prefix-cut trials per scalar; repeated observations are intentional tests of distinct cuts, not proved duplicate work.

ratios.name: loopC2CacheHitShare
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Invocation-local C2 cache hits / C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC2RowsPerNativeQuery
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Returned C2 rows / actual uncached C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC5ChecksPerNewPlan
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Native entry/row preparation checks per newly prepared plan.

ratios.name: loopPreparedC5Share
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Successful prepared C5 queries / (prepared successes + native fallbacks).

ratios.name: loopSavedPositionsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Saved output positions examined per selector query. Selector totals mix real replay and pure observations.

ratios.name: loopSavedViewsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Reversed selected views per selector query; not a unique-record count.

ratios.name: loopPublicationSelectedVsLinearBound
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Index-selected publication candidates / theoretical complete linear-pair bound. The bound is not work actually performed.

ratios.name: loopCallbacksPerNativeMatch
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: DATA callbacks / successful native local relation matches; counts can include ND and multi-output geometry.

ratios.name: selectedCallEmptyDemandShare
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Empty demand lookups / all selected-call demand lookups.

ratios.name: persistedCandidatesPerReplay
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Candidate records / persisted replay invocation, not duplicate facts.

ratios.name: newInitialsPerCandidate
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Admitted fresh initials / initial candidates under the native admission counter.

ratios.name: cyclicProcessedShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; exact packet events
ratios.interpretation: Cyclic-CFG processed packet share; not a causation/provenance proof.

ratios.name: candidateOffersPerProcessed
ratios.scope: all measured actors; different packet-event stages
ratios.interpretation: Stage volume ratio; not a duplicate-work percentage.

ratios.name: blockCandidateShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; summary candidate packets
ratios.interpretation: Internal-block share of summary candidate offers.

ratios.name: cfgCacheHitShare
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG delivery calls
ratios.interpretation: Cache hits / (hits + searches).

ratios.name: cfgNodesPerSearch
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG BFS
ratios.interpretation: Visited CFG nodes per cache miss search.

ratios.name: loopObservationsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Observation invocations per scalar subject to the growing-summary gate; each baseline and each cut trial invokes observe.

ratios.name: loopTrialsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Prefix-cut trials per scalar; repeated observations are intentional tests of distinct cuts, not proved duplicate work.

ratios.name: loopC2CacheHitShare
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Invocation-local C2 cache hits / C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC2RowsPerNativeQuery
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Returned C2 rows / actual uncached C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC5ChecksPerNewPlan
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Native entry/row preparation checks per newly prepared plan.

ratios.name: loopPreparedC5Share
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Successful prepared C5 queries / (prepared successes + native fallbacks).

ratios.name: loopSavedPositionsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Saved output positions examined per selector query. Selector totals mix real replay and pure observations.

ratios.name: loopSavedViewsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Reversed selected views per selector query; not a unique-record count.

ratios.name: loopPublicationSelectedVsLinearBound
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Index-selected publication candidates / theoretical complete linear-pair bound. The bound is not work actually performed.

ratios.name: loopCallbacksPerNativeMatch
ratios.scope: 24 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: DATA callbacks / successful native local relation matches; counts can include ND and multi-output geometry.

ratios.name: selectedCallEmptyDemandShare
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Empty demand lookups / all selected-call demand lookups.

ratios.name: persistedCandidatesPerReplay
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Candidate records / persisted replay invocation, not duplicate facts.

ratios.name: newInitialsPerCandidate
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Admitted fresh initials / initial candidates under the native admission counter.

sampledAnnotationRatios.name: processedSampledMembershipsPerPacket
sampledAnnotationRatios.interpretation: Annotation multiplicity of sampled packets; not an exact population-wide edge count.

sampledAnnotationRatios.name: freshPostSSampledMembershipsPerPacket
sampledAnnotationRatios.interpretation: Annotation multiplicity of sampled packets; not an exact population-wide edge count.

sampledAnnotationRatios.name: summaryCandidateSampledMembershipsPerPacket
sampledAnnotationRatios.interpretation: Annotation multiplicity of sampled packets; not an exact population-wide edge count.

ratios.name: cyclicProcessedShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; exact packet events
ratios.interpretation: Cyclic-CFG processed packet share; not a causation/provenance proof.

ratios.name: candidateOffersPerProcessed
ratios.scope: all measured actors; different packet-event stages
ratios.interpretation: Stage volume ratio; not a duplicate-work percentage.

ratios.name: blockCandidateShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; summary candidate packets
ratios.interpretation: Internal-block share of summary candidate offers.

ratios.name: cfgCacheHitShare
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG delivery calls
ratios.interpretation: Cache hits / (hits + searches).

ratios.name: cfgNodesPerSearch
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG BFS
ratios.interpretation: Visited CFG nodes per cache miss search.

ratios.name: loopObservationsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 22 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Observation invocations per scalar subject to the growing-summary gate; each baseline and each cut trial invokes observe.

ratios.name: loopTrialsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 22 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Prefix-cut trials per scalar; repeated observations are intentional tests of distinct cuts, not proved duplicate work.

ratios.name: loopC2CacheHitShare
ratios.scope: 22 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Invocation-local C2 cache hits / C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC2RowsPerNativeQuery
ratios.scope: 22 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Returned C2 rows / actual uncached C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC5ChecksPerNewPlan
ratios.scope: 22 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Native entry/row preparation checks per newly prepared plan.

ratios.name: loopPreparedC5Share
ratios.scope: 22 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Successful prepared C5 queries / (prepared successes + native fallbacks).

ratios.name: loopSavedPositionsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 22 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Saved output positions examined per selector query. Selector totals mix real replay and pure observations.

ratios.name: loopSavedViewsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 22 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Reversed selected views per selector query; not a unique-record count.

ratios.name: loopPublicationSelectedVsLinearBound
ratios.scope: 22 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Index-selected publication candidates / theoretical complete linear-pair bound. The bound is not work actually performed.

ratios.name: loopCallbacksPerNativeMatch
ratios.scope: 22 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: DATA callbacks / successful native local relation matches; counts can include ND and multi-output geometry.

ratios.name: selectedCallEmptyDemandShare
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Empty demand lookups / all selected-call demand lookups.

ratios.name: persistedCandidatesPerReplay
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Candidate records / persisted replay invocation, not duplicate facts.

ratios.name: newInitialsPerCandidate
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Admitted fresh initials / initial candidates under the native admission counter.

sampledAnnotationRatios.name: processedSampledMembershipsPerPacket
sampledAnnotationRatios.interpretation: Annotation multiplicity of sampled packets; not an exact population-wide edge count.

sampledAnnotationRatios.interpretation: Annotation multiplicity of sampled packets; not an exact population-wide edge count.

sampledAnnotationRatios.name: summaryCandidateSampledMembershipsPerPacket
sampledAnnotationRatios.interpretation: Annotation multiplicity of sampled packets; not an exact population-wide edge count.

ratios.name: cyclicProcessedShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; exact packet events
ratios.interpretation: Cyclic-CFG processed packet share; not a causation/provenance proof.

ratios.name: candidateOffersPerProcessed
ratios.scope: all measured actors; different packet-event stages
ratios.interpretation: Stage volume ratio; not a duplicate-work percentage.

ratios.name: blockCandidateShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; summary candidate packets
ratios.interpretation: Internal-block share of summary candidate offers.

ratios.name: cfgCacheHitShare
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG delivery calls
ratios.interpretation: Cache hits / (hits + searches).

ratios.name: cfgNodesPerSearch
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG BFS
ratios.interpretation: Visited CFG nodes per cache miss search.

ratios.name: loopObservationsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 16 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Observation invocations per scalar subject to the growing-summary gate; each baseline and each cut trial invokes observe.

ratios.name: loopTrialsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 16 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Prefix-cut trials per scalar; repeated observations are intentional tests of distinct cuts, not proved duplicate work.

ratios.name: loopC2CacheHitShare
ratios.scope: 16 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Invocation-local C2 cache hits / C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC2RowsPerNativeQuery
ratios.scope: 16 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Returned C2 rows / actual uncached C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC5ChecksPerNewPlan
ratios.scope: 16 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Native entry/row preparation checks per newly prepared plan.

ratios.name: loopPreparedC5Share
ratios.scope: 16 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Successful prepared C5 queries / (prepared successes + native fallbacks).

ratios.name: loopSavedPositionsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 16 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Saved output positions examined per selector query. Selector totals mix real replay and pure observations.

ratios.name: loopSavedViewsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 16 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Reversed selected views per selector query; not a unique-record count.

ratios.name: loopPublicationSelectedVsLinearBound
ratios.scope: 16 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Index-selected publication candidates / theoretical complete linear-pair bound. The bound is not work actually performed.

ratios.name: loopCallbacksPerNativeMatch
ratios.scope: 16 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: DATA callbacks / successful native local relation matches; counts can include ND and multi-output geometry.

ratios.name: selectedCallEmptyDemandShare
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Empty demand lookups / all selected-call demand lookups.

ratios.name: persistedCandidatesPerReplay
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Candidate records / persisted replay invocation, not duplicate facts.

ratios.name: newInitialsPerCandidate
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Admitted fresh initials / initial candidates under the native admission counter.

ratios.name: cyclicProcessedShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; exact packet events
ratios.interpretation: Cyclic-CFG processed packet share; not a causation/provenance proof.

ratios.name: candidateOffersPerProcessed
ratios.scope: all measured actors; different packet-event stages
ratios.interpretation: Stage volume ratio; not a duplicate-work percentage.

ratios.name: blockCandidateShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; summary candidate packets
ratios.interpretation: Internal-block share of summary candidate offers.

ratios.name: cfgCacheHitShare
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG delivery calls
ratios.interpretation: Cache hits / (hits + searches).

ratios.name: cfgNodesPerSearch
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG BFS
ratios.interpretation: Visited CFG nodes per cache miss search.

ratios.name: loopObservationsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Observation invocations per scalar subject to the growing-summary gate; each baseline and each cut trial invokes observe.

ratios.name: loopTrialsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Prefix-cut trials per scalar; repeated observations are intentional tests of distinct cuts, not proved duplicate work.

ratios.name: loopC2CacheHitShare
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Invocation-local C2 cache hits / C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC2RowsPerNativeQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Returned C2 rows / actual uncached C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC5ChecksPerNewPlan
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Native entry/row preparation checks per newly prepared plan.

ratios.name: loopPreparedC5Share
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Successful prepared C5 queries / (prepared successes + native fallbacks).

ratios.name: loopSavedPositionsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Saved output positions examined per selector query. Selector totals mix real replay and pure observations.

ratios.name: loopSavedViewsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Reversed selected views per selector query; not a unique-record count.

ratios.name: loopPublicationSelectedVsLinearBound
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Index-selected publication candidates / theoretical complete linear-pair bound. The bound is not work actually performed.

ratios.name: loopCallbacksPerNativeMatch
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: DATA callbacks / successful native local relation matches; counts can include ND and multi-output geometry.

ratios.name: selectedCallEmptyDemandShare
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Empty demand lookups / all selected-call demand lookups.

ratios.name: persistedCandidatesPerReplay
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Candidate records / persisted replay invocation, not duplicate facts.

ratios.name: newInitialsPerCandidate
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Admitted fresh initials / initial candidates under the native admission counter.

sampledAnnotationRatios.interpretation: Annotation multiplicity of sampled packets; not an exact population-wide edge count.

ratios.name: cyclicProcessedShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; exact packet events
ratios.interpretation: Cyclic-CFG processed packet share; not a causation/provenance proof.

ratios.name: candidateOffersPerProcessed
ratios.scope: all measured actors; different packet-event stages
ratios.interpretation: Stage volume ratio; not a duplicate-work percentage.

ratios.name: blockCandidateShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; summary candidate packets
ratios.interpretation: Internal-block share of summary candidate offers.

ratios.name: cfgCacheHitShare
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG delivery calls
ratios.interpretation: Cache hits / (hits + searches).

ratios.name: cfgNodesPerSearch
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG BFS
ratios.interpretation: Visited CFG nodes per cache miss search.

ratios.name: loopObservationsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Observation invocations per scalar subject to the growing-summary gate; each baseline and each cut trial invokes observe.

ratios.name: loopTrialsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Prefix-cut trials per scalar; repeated observations are intentional tests of distinct cuts, not proved duplicate work.

ratios.name: loopC2CacheHitShare
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Invocation-local C2 cache hits / C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC2RowsPerNativeQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Returned C2 rows / actual uncached C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC5ChecksPerNewPlan
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Native entry/row preparation checks per newly prepared plan.

ratios.name: loopPreparedC5Share
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Successful prepared C5 queries / (prepared successes + native fallbacks).

ratios.name: loopSavedPositionsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Saved output positions examined per selector query. Selector totals mix real replay and pure observations.

ratios.name: loopSavedViewsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Reversed selected views per selector query; not a unique-record count.

ratios.name: loopPublicationSelectedVsLinearBound
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Index-selected publication candidates / theoretical complete linear-pair bound. The bound is not work actually performed.

ratios.name: loopCallbacksPerNativeMatch
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: DATA callbacks / successful native local relation matches; counts can include ND and multi-output geometry.

ratios.name: selectedCallEmptyDemandShare
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Empty demand lookups / all selected-call demand lookups.

ratios.name: persistedCandidatesPerReplay
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Candidate records / persisted replay invocation, not duplicate facts.

ratios.name: newInitialsPerCandidate
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Admitted fresh initials / initial candidates under the native admission counter.

sampledAnnotationRatios.interpretation: Annotation multiplicity of sampled packets; not an exact population-wide edge count.

ratios.name: cyclicProcessedShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; exact packet events
ratios.interpretation: Cyclic-CFG processed packet share; not a causation/provenance proof.

ratios.name: candidateOffersPerProcessed
ratios.scope: all measured actors; different packet-event stages
ratios.interpretation: Stage volume ratio; not a duplicate-work percentage.

ratios.name: blockCandidateShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; summary candidate packets
ratios.interpretation: Internal-block share of summary candidate offers.

ratios.name: cfgCacheHitShare
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG delivery calls
ratios.interpretation: Cache hits / (hits + searches).

ratios.name: cfgNodesPerSearch
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG BFS
ratios.interpretation: Visited CFG nodes per cache miss search.

ratios.name: loopObservationsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Observation invocations per scalar subject to the growing-summary gate; each baseline and each cut trial invokes observe.

ratios.name: loopTrialsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Prefix-cut trials per scalar; repeated observations are intentional tests of distinct cuts, not proved duplicate work.

ratios.name: loopC2CacheHitShare
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Invocation-local C2 cache hits / C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC2RowsPerNativeQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Returned C2 rows / actual uncached C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC5ChecksPerNewPlan
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Native entry/row preparation checks per newly prepared plan.

ratios.name: loopPreparedC5Share
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Successful prepared C5 queries / (prepared successes + native fallbacks).

ratios.name: loopSavedPositionsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Saved output positions examined per selector query. Selector totals mix real replay and pure observations.

ratios.name: loopSavedViewsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Reversed selected views per selector query; not a unique-record count.

ratios.name: loopPublicationSelectedVsLinearBound
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Index-selected publication candidates / theoretical complete linear-pair bound. The bound is not work actually performed.

ratios.name: loopCallbacksPerNativeMatch
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: DATA callbacks / successful native local relation matches; counts can include ND and multi-output geometry.

ratios.name: selectedCallEmptyDemandShare
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Empty demand lookups / all selected-call demand lookups.

ratios.name: persistedCandidatesPerReplay
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Candidate records / persisted replay invocation, not duplicate facts.

ratios.name: newInitialsPerCandidate
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Admitted fresh initials / initial candidates under the native admission counter.

ratios.name: cyclicProcessedShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; exact packet events
ratios.interpretation: Cyclic-CFG processed packet share; not a causation/provenance proof.

ratios.name: candidateOffersPerProcessed
ratios.scope: all measured actors; different packet-event stages
ratios.interpretation: Stage volume ratio; not a duplicate-work percentage.

ratios.name: blockCandidateShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; summary candidate packets
ratios.interpretation: Internal-block share of summary candidate offers.

ratios.name: cfgCacheHitShare
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG delivery calls
ratios.interpretation: Cache hits / (hits + searches).

ratios.name: cfgNodesPerSearch
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG BFS
ratios.interpretation: Visited CFG nodes per cache miss search.

ratios.name: loopObservationsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Observation invocations per scalar subject to the growing-summary gate; each baseline and each cut trial invokes observe.

ratios.name: loopTrialsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Prefix-cut trials per scalar; repeated observations are intentional tests of distinct cuts, not proved duplicate work.

ratios.name: loopC2CacheHitShare
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Invocation-local C2 cache hits / C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC2RowsPerNativeQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Returned C2 rows / actual uncached C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC5ChecksPerNewPlan
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Native entry/row preparation checks per newly prepared plan.

ratios.name: loopPreparedC5Share
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Successful prepared C5 queries / (prepared successes + native fallbacks).

ratios.name: loopSavedPositionsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Saved output positions examined per selector query. Selector totals mix real replay and pure observations.

ratios.name: loopSavedViewsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Reversed selected views per selector query; not a unique-record count.

ratios.name: loopPublicationSelectedVsLinearBound
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Index-selected publication candidates / theoretical complete linear-pair bound. The bound is not work actually performed.

ratios.name: loopCallbacksPerNativeMatch
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: DATA callbacks / successful native local relation matches; counts can include ND and multi-output geometry.

ratios.name: selectedCallEmptyDemandShare
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Empty demand lookups / all selected-call demand lookups.

ratios.name: persistedCandidatesPerReplay
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Candidate records / persisted replay invocation, not duplicate facts.

ratios.name: newInitialsPerCandidate
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Admitted fresh initials / initial candidates under the native admission counter.

sampledAnnotationRatios.interpretation: Annotation multiplicity of sampled packets; not an exact population-wide edge count.

sampledAnnotationRatios.interpretation: Annotation multiplicity of sampled packets; not an exact population-wide edge count.

ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Reversed selected views per selector query; not a unique-record count.

ratios.name: loopPublicationSelectedVsLinearBound
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Index-selected publication candidates / theoretical complete linear-pair bound. The bound is not work actually performed.

ratios.name: loopCallbacksPerNativeMatch

ratios.interpretation: DATA callbacks / successful native local relation matches; counts can include ND and multi-output geometry.

ratios.name: cyclicProcessedShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; exact packet events
ratios.interpretation: Cyclic-CFG processed packet share; not a causation/provenance proof.

ratios.name: candidateOffersPerProcessed
ratios.scope: all measured actors; different packet-event stages
ratios.interpretation: Stage volume ratio; not a duplicate-work percentage.

ratios.name: blockCandidateShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; summary candidate packets
ratios.interpretation: Internal-block share of summary candidate offers.

ratios.name: cfgCacheHitShare
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG delivery calls
ratios.interpretation: Cache hits / (hits + searches).

ratios.name: cfgNodesPerSearch
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG BFS
ratios.interpretation: Visited CFG nodes per cache miss search.

ratios.name: loopObservationsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Observation invocations per scalar subject to the growing-summary gate; each baseline and each cut trial invokes observe.

ratios.name: loopTrialsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Prefix-cut trials per scalar; repeated observations are intentional tests of distinct cuts, not proved duplicate work.

ratios.name: loopC2CacheHitShare
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Invocation-local C2 cache hits / C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC2RowsPerNativeQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Returned C2 rows / actual uncached C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC5ChecksPerNewPlan
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Native entry/row preparation checks per newly prepared plan.

ratios.name: loopPreparedC5Share
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Successful prepared C5 queries / (prepared successes + native fallbacks).

ratios.name: loopSavedPositionsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Saved output positions examined per selector query. Selector totals mix real replay and pure observations.

ratios.name: loopSavedViewsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Reversed selected views per selector query; not a unique-record count.

ratios.name: loopPublicationSelectedVsLinearBound
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Index-selected publication candidates / theoretical complete linear-pair bound. The bound is not work actually performed.

ratios.name: loopCallbacksPerNativeMatch
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: DATA callbacks / successful native local relation matches; counts can include ND and multi-output geometry.

ratios.name: selectedCallEmptyDemandShare
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Empty demand lookups / all selected-call demand lookups.

ratios.name: persistedCandidatesPerReplay
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Candidate records / persisted replay invocation, not duplicate facts.

ratios.name: newInitialsPerCandidate
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Admitted fresh initials / initial candidates under the native admission counter.

ratios.name: cyclicProcessedShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; exact packet events
ratios.interpretation: Cyclic-CFG processed packet share; not a causation/provenance proof.

ratios.name: candidateOffersPerProcessed
ratios.scope: all measured actors; different packet-event stages
ratios.interpretation: Stage volume ratio; not a duplicate-work percentage.

ratios.name: blockCandidateShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; summary candidate packets
ratios.interpretation: Internal-block share of summary candidate offers.

ratios.name: cfgCacheHitShare
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG delivery calls
ratios.interpretation: Cache hits / (hits + searches).

ratios.name: cfgNodesPerSearch
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG BFS
ratios.interpretation: Visited CFG nodes per cache miss search.

ratios.name: loopObservationsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Observation invocations per scalar subject to the growing-summary gate; each baseline and each cut trial invokes observe.

ratios.name: loopTrialsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Prefix-cut trials per scalar; repeated observations are intentional tests of distinct cuts, not proved duplicate work.

ratios.name: loopC2CacheHitShare
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Invocation-local C2 cache hits / C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC2RowsPerNativeQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Returned C2 rows / actual uncached C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC5ChecksPerNewPlan
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Native entry/row preparation checks per newly prepared plan.

ratios.name: loopPreparedC5Share
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Successful prepared C5 queries / (prepared successes + native fallbacks).

ratios.name: loopSavedPositionsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Saved output positions examined per selector query. Selector totals mix real replay and pure observations.

ratios.name: loopSavedViewsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Reversed selected views per selector query; not a unique-record count.

ratios.name: loopPublicationSelectedVsLinearBound
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Index-selected publication candidates / theoretical complete linear-pair bound. The bound is not work actually performed.

ratios.name: loopCallbacksPerNativeMatch
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: DATA callbacks / successful native local relation matches; counts can include ND and multi-output geometry.

ratios.name: selectedCallEmptyDemandShare
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Empty demand lookups / all selected-call demand lookups.

ratios.name: persistedCandidatesPerReplay
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Candidate records / persisted replay invocation, not duplicate facts.

ratios.name: newInitialsPerCandidate
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Admitted fresh initials / initial candidates under the native admission counter.

sampledAnnotationRatios.interpretation: Annotation multiplicity of sampled packets; not an exact population-wide edge count.

sampledAnnotationRatios.interpretation: Annotation multiplicity of sampled packets; not an exact population-wide edge count.

ratios.name: loopPublicationSelectedVsLinearBound

ratios.name: loopCallbacksPerNativeMatch

ratios.name: cyclicProcessedShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; exact packet events
ratios.interpretation: Cyclic-CFG processed packet share; not a causation/provenance proof.

ratios.name: candidateOffersPerProcessed
ratios.scope: all measured actors; different packet-event stages
ratios.interpretation: Stage volume ratio; not a duplicate-work percentage.

ratios.name: blockCandidateShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; summary candidate packets
ratios.interpretation: Internal-block share of summary candidate offers.

ratios.name: cfgCacheHitShare
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG delivery calls
ratios.interpretation: Cache hits / (hits + searches).

ratios.name: cfgNodesPerSearch
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG BFS
ratios.interpretation: Visited CFG nodes per cache miss search.

ratios.name: loopObservationsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Observation invocations per scalar subject to the growing-summary gate; each baseline and each cut trial invokes observe.

ratios.name: loopTrialsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Prefix-cut trials per scalar; repeated observations are intentional tests of distinct cuts, not proved duplicate work.

ratios.name: loopC2CacheHitShare
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Invocation-local C2 cache hits / C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC2RowsPerNativeQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Returned C2 rows / actual uncached C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC5ChecksPerNewPlan
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Native entry/row preparation checks per newly prepared plan.

ratios.name: loopPreparedC5Share
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Successful prepared C5 queries / (prepared successes + native fallbacks).

ratios.name: loopSavedPositionsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Saved output positions examined per selector query. Selector totals mix real replay and pure observations.

ratios.name: loopSavedViewsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Reversed selected views per selector query; not a unique-record count.

ratios.name: loopPublicationSelectedVsLinearBound
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Index-selected publication candidates / theoretical complete linear-pair bound. The bound is not work actually performed.

ratios.name: loopCallbacksPerNativeMatch
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: DATA callbacks / successful native local relation matches; counts can include ND and multi-output geometry.

ratios.name: selectedCallEmptyDemandShare
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Empty demand lookups / all selected-call demand lookups.

ratios.name: persistedCandidatesPerReplay
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Candidate records / persisted replay invocation, not duplicate facts.

ratios.name: newInitialsPerCandidate
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Admitted fresh initials / initial candidates under the native admission counter.

sampledAnnotationRatios.name: processedSampledMembershipsPerPacket
sampledAnnotationRatios.interpretation: Annotation multiplicity of sampled packets; not an exact population-wide edge count.

sampledAnnotationRatios.interpretation: Annotation multiplicity of sampled packets; not an exact population-wide edge count.

ratios.name: loopPublicationSelectedVsLinearBound

ratios.name: cyclicProcessedShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; exact packet events
ratios.interpretation: Cyclic-CFG processed packet share; not a causation/provenance proof.

ratios.name: candidateOffersPerProcessed
ratios.scope: all measured actors; different packet-event stages
ratios.interpretation: Stage volume ratio; not a duplicate-work percentage.

ratios.name: blockCandidateShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; summary candidate packets
ratios.interpretation: Internal-block share of summary candidate offers.

ratios.name: cfgCacheHitShare
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG delivery calls
ratios.interpretation: Cache hits / (hits + searches).

ratios.name: cfgNodesPerSearch
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG BFS
ratios.interpretation: Visited CFG nodes per cache miss search.

ratios.name: loopObservationsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Observation invocations per scalar subject to the growing-summary gate; each baseline and each cut trial invokes observe.

ratios.name: loopTrialsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Prefix-cut trials per scalar; repeated observations are intentional tests of distinct cuts, not proved duplicate work.

ratios.name: loopC2CacheHitShare
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Invocation-local C2 cache hits / C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC2RowsPerNativeQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Returned C2 rows / actual uncached C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC5ChecksPerNewPlan
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Native entry/row preparation checks per newly prepared plan.

ratios.name: loopPreparedC5Share
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Successful prepared C5 queries / (prepared successes + native fallbacks).

ratios.name: loopSavedPositionsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Saved output positions examined per selector query. Selector totals mix real replay and pure observations.

ratios.name: loopSavedViewsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Reversed selected views per selector query; not a unique-record count.

ratios.name: loopPublicationSelectedVsLinearBound
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Index-selected publication candidates / theoretical complete linear-pair bound. The bound is not work actually performed.

ratios.name: loopCallbacksPerNativeMatch
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: DATA callbacks / successful native local relation matches; counts can include ND and multi-output geometry.

ratios.name: selectedCallEmptyDemandShare
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Empty demand lookups / all selected-call demand lookups.

ratios.name: persistedCandidatesPerReplay
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Candidate records / persisted replay invocation, not duplicate facts.

ratios.name: newInitialsPerCandidate
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Admitted fresh initials / initial candidates under the native admission counter.

ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Reversed selected views per selector query; not a unique-record count.

ratios.name: loopPublicationSelectedVsLinearBound
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Index-selected publication candidates / theoretical complete linear-pair bound. The bound is not work actually performed.

ratios.name: loopCallbacksPerNativeMatch

ratios.interpretation: DATA callbacks / successful native local relation matches; counts can include ND and multi-output geometry.

ratios.name: cyclicProcessedShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; exact packet events
ratios.interpretation: Cyclic-CFG processed packet share; not a causation/provenance proof.

ratios.name: candidateOffersPerProcessed
ratios.scope: all measured actors; different packet-event stages
ratios.interpretation: Stage volume ratio; not a duplicate-work percentage.

ratios.name: blockCandidateShare
ratios.scope: all measured actors; summary candidate packets
ratios.interpretation: Internal-block share of summary candidate offers.

ratios.name: cfgCacheHitShare
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG delivery calls
ratios.interpretation: Cache hits / (hits + searches).

ratios.name: cfgNodesPerSearch
ratios.scope: all exported run actors; CFG BFS
ratios.interpretation: Visited CFG nodes per cache miss search.

ratios.name: loopObservationsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Observation invocations per scalar subject to the growing-summary gate; each baseline and each cut trial invokes observe.

ratios.name: loopTrialsPerScalar
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Prefix-cut trials per scalar; repeated observations are intentional tests of distinct cuts, not proved duplicate work.

ratios.name: loopC2CacheHitShare
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Invocation-local C2 cache hits / C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC2RowsPerNativeQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Returned C2 rows / actual uncached C2 queries.

ratios.name: loopC5ChecksPerNewPlan
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Native entry/row preparation checks per newly prepared plan.

ratios.name: loopPreparedC5Share
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Successful prepared C5 queries / (prepared successes + native fallbacks).

ratios.name: loopSavedPositionsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Saved output positions examined per selector query. Selector totals mix real replay and pure observations.

ratios.name: loopSavedViewsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Reversed selected views per selector query; not a unique-record count.

ratios.name: loopPublicationSelectedVsLinearBound
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: Index-selected publication candidates / theoretical complete linear-pair bound. The bound is not work actually performed.

ratios.name: loopCallbacksPerNativeMatch
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census
ratios.interpretation: DATA callbacks / successful native local relation matches; counts can include ND and multi-output geometry.

ratios.name: selectedCallEmptyDemandShare
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Empty demand lookups / all selected-call demand lookups.

ratios.name: persistedCandidatesPerReplay
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Candidate records / persisted replay invocation, not duplicate facts.

ratios.name: newInitialsPerCandidate
ratios.scope: per-run END−START shared operation counters
ratios.interpretation: Admitted fresh initials / initial candidates under the native admission counter.

sampledAnnotationRatios.interpretation: Annotation multiplicity of sampled packets; not an exact population-wide edge count.

ratios.name: loopSavedViewsPerQuery
ratios.scope: 15 printed hot loop owners only; not a run-wide census

ratios.name: loopPublicationSelectedVsLinearBound

ratios.name: loopCallbacksPerNativeMatch
